description: Defines the 'processor_notifier_adaptor' class which adapts various processor notifications for the lower physical layer in a radio communication system. It includes nested classes for specific processor adaptors and provides getter methods for each notifier.

classes.name: processor_notifier_adaptor
classes.description: Adapts processor notifications to lower physical layer interfaces, containing nested classes for specific processor adaptors.

classes.name: downlink_adaptor
classes.description: Internal class that implements downlink_processor_notifier interface, forwarding notifications to registered notifiers.

classes.name: uplink_adaptor
classes.description: Internal class that implements uplink_processor_notifier interface, forwarding notifications to registered notifiers.

classes.name: pdxch_adaptor
classes.description: Internal class that implements pdxch_processor_notifier interface, forwarding requests to error notifier.

classes.name: prach_adaptor
classes.description: Internal class that implements prach_processor_notifier interface, forwarding requests and window notifications.

classes.name: puxch_adaptor
classes.description: Internal class that implements puxch_processor_notifier interface, forwarding requests and symbol receptions.

methods.name: get_downlink_notifier
methods.description: Returns reference to the downlink processor notifier adaptor.

methods.name: get_pdxch_notifier
methods.description: Returns reference to the PDxCH processor notifier adaptor.

methods.name: get_uplink_notifier
methods.description: Returns reference to the uplink processor notifier adaptor.

methods.name: get_prach_notifier
methods.description: Returns reference to the PRACH processor notifier adaptor.

methods.name: get_puxch_notifier
methods.description: Returns reference to the PUxCH processor notifier adaptor.
